words.definition: Of high quality, or enjoyable.

words.definition: Not good, or unpleasant.

words.definition: Pleasant or kind.

words.definition: Very pleasant to look at or experience.

words.definition: Liked more than all others of its kind.
words.example: Pizza is my favorite food.

words.definition: Making you laugh.
words.example: Your brother is so funny!

words.definition: Holding your attention and making you want to know more.
words.example: That's an interesting idea.

words.definition: Having a very good taste.
words.example: This cake is delicious!

words.definition: As good as it can possibly be.
words.example: Thursday is perfect for me.

words.definition: Not correct or not right.

words.definition: A path or method.

words.definition: An object, action or idea you do not name.

words.definition: At a time after now.
words.example: I'll call you later.

words.definition: Two times.
words.example: I go to the gym twice a week.

words.definition: On the night of today.
words.example: What are you doing tonight?

words.definition: At an unknown time in the future.
words.example: I want to visit Japan someday.

words.definition: At any time.

words.definition: The study of numbers and shapes.
words.example: I'm bad at math.

words.definition: The study of the natural world through experiments and facts.

words.definition: The study of past events.

words.definition: The study of countries, land, rivers and climate.

words.definition: A system of words that people use to communicate, like English.

words.definition: The rules for how words are put together in a language.

words.definition: All the words you know in a language.
words.example: I learn five new vocabulary words a day.

words.definition: A book or website that explains the meaning of words.

words.definition: An area of study, like math or history.

words.definition: The thin threads that grow on your head.

words.example: He's growing a beard.

words.definition: Sweet and attractive, often small or young.

words.definition: Good-looking. Usually used for men.
words.example: Her husband is very handsome.

words.definition: Nice to look at.

words.example: Sweep the floor before the guests arrive.

words.definition: To make a place neat by putting things where they belong.
words.example: Tidy your room before dinner.

words.definition: A substance you use with water to wash things.

words.example: The broom is behind the door.

words.definition: A soft object that holds water, used for washing.

words.definition: To make clothes flat and smooth with a hot tool.

words.definition: A decision about what you will do.

words.definition: A thought or suggestion.

words.definition: Not busy, or available.

words.definition: Possibly; perhaps.
words.example: Maybe we could meet after work.

words.definition: Very likely.
words.example: I'll probably be late.

words.definition: To make a choice after thinking about it.
words.example: We need to decide by Friday.

words.definition: To say that something planned will not happen.
words.example: I have to cancel our lunch. Sorry!

words.definition: To plan and organize something in advance.

words.example: I suggest we leave early.

words.definition: Prepared and able to do something.

words.definition: A young person who is not yet an adult.

words.definition: A man, woman or child.

words.definition: A person who studies at a school or university.

words.definition: A male child of a parent.
words.example: Their son plays the guitar.

words.definition: A female child of a parent.

words.definition: A man who rules a country.
words.example: The king gave a speech.

words.definition: A polite word for a woman.

words.definition: A polite or well-mannered man.
words.example: He's a real gentleman.

words.definition: A person who hates you or wants to harm you.
words.example: They became bitter enemies.

words.definition: A student at a school, or the dark center of your eye.
words.example: The teacher has twenty pupils.

words.definition: Feeling fear.
words.example: I'm afraid of dogs.

words.definition: Feeling strong dislike or annoyance.
words.example: He was angry about the delay.

words.definition: Worried and a little afraid about something.
words.example: I'm nervous about my interview.

words.definition: Pleased about something good you or others have done.
words.example: My parents are proud of me.

words.definition: Sad because you have no friends or company.
words.example: She felt lonely in the new city.

words.definition: Feeling that something was unexpected.
words.example: I was surprised to see you here.

words.definition: Quiet and not worried or excited.
words.example: Stay calm. Everything will be okay.

words.definition: Unhappy or worried because of something bad.
words.example: She's upset because she failed the test.

words.definition: Not able to understand something clearly.
words.example: I'm confused. Can you explain it again?

words.definition: Calm and free from worry.
words.example: I feel so relaxed on vacation.
